shots.narration: [softly] 我叫“希望”。很久以前，我是一头年幼的蓝鲸。1891年3月25日清晨，我搁浅在爱尔兰韦克斯福德港口的一片沙洲上。
shots.action: First the huge blue whale skeleton hanging in a museum hall softly fills out into a living blue whale. Then she swims through open ocean and does one slow roll. Then, at dawn, she drifts into shallow water and comes to rest on a pale sandbar as small waves wash around her.
shots.camera: Slow rise from the floor of the hall, then a gentle tracking shot beside her, ending in a slow push in at water level.
shots.location: A grand Romanesque museum hall with terracotta arches, then deep blue open ocean, then the mouth of a harbour on the Irish coast at dawn in 1891.

shots.narration: 我的骨架被自然历史博物馆以250英镑买下。2017年7月，我在辛兹大厅揭幕。人们叫我“希望”，象征人类有力量塑造可持续的未来。
shots.action: First the whale floats past wooden crates in a storeroom as her body turns softly translucent, a glowing skeleton showing inside. Then she sweeps down into a grand museum hall in one long glide as visitors look up, turns to face the viewer and comes gently closer.
shots.camera: Slow sideways dolly, then a wide shot following her glide, ending at eye level with a slow push in to her eye.
shots.location: A dim Victorian museum storeroom with warm gas lamps, then a grand Romanesque museum hall with terracotta arches in bright daylight.
shots.mood: Curious, then soaring, then warm and hopeful.
